notes: b(k)/k -> 10 proved in Lean (A065255_main: Nat.nth B k / (k+1) -> 10, B = {n >= 1 : sigma(n) = n mod 10}). A prime p = 9 mod 10 dividing n exactly once forces 10 | sigma(n) (A065255_ten_dvd_sigma, A065255_iff); the n without such a prime have density 0 (A065255_exceptional_density_zero: library sieve density_zero_of_sieve fed by Dirichlet's divergence of sum 1/p over p = 9 mod 10, not_summable_one_div_prime_mod, both in OpenProblemsLib.PNTApps); B agrees with the multiples of 10 off that set (A065255_density). count.py: x/#B(x) = 9.979 at 3e6. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
